definitions.explanation: Communicated by speaking rather than in writing. Used as a noun modifier (with の) to describe instructions, agreements, explanations, and other forms of communication that are delivered orally.

examples.japanese: {口頭|こうとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
{口頭|こうとう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The oral examination will be held next Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{口頭|こうとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていない→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Since it was a verbal promise rather than a written one, there is no evidence left.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口頭|こうとう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (oral examination)
- {口頭|こうとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (convey orally)
- {口頭|こうとう}⟦{弁論|べんろん}→弁論：24557_benron⟧ (oral argument, court hearing)
- {口頭|こうとう}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (verbal warning)

Almost always used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or in compound nouns. The contrast is with ⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧ (written) or ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧ (document). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{高等|こうとう}→高等：04184_koutou⟧ (high-level, advanced).
